integrity: Proof uses exact product spectrum and global convex averaging; standalone tests are supplementary and do not prove universal quantifiers. No independent validation was performed.
limitations: Symmetric stochastic walks with holding, undirected unweighted H that is connected and both vertex- and edge-transitive; formula gives an optimal invariant walk but not unrestricted uniqueness, and does not assert finite-time mixing optimality. Specialized previously published coverage cannot be completely excluded.
title: Sharp holding transitions in fastest mixing on clique-layer products
